methods.name: runProtocolLocally
methods.docu:
Run an authentication protocol locally.

Parameters:

  • p_client Client context
  • p_factory Server context factory

Returns: Either an error or empty if successful

methods.name: runProtocolLocally

Run an authentication protocol locally.

methods.name: runProtocolLocallyUsingThreads

methods.name: runProtocolLocallyUsingThreads
methods.docu:
Run an authentication protocol locally.using threads. I mainly implemented this to demonstrate what the protocol API looks like when the client and server are separated by a channel, which better reflects what it will look like when incorporated into an actual network protocol.

Parameters:

  • p_client Client context
  • p_factory Server context factory
  • p_localAddress Local SocketAddress to use
  • p_remoteAddress Remote SocketAddress to use

Returns: Either an error or empty if successful

methods.name: readDefaultPrivateKeyStorage
methods.docu:
Read the private key at the default location. This will return an empty Optional if the location does not exist instead of throwing an exception. It should only throw throw an exception if the location actually exists but there is an issue reading a private key from it.

Returns: The private key or empty if the location did not exist

Returns: The private key or empty if the location did not exist

methods.name: readRelativeDefaultPrivateKeyStorage
methods.docu:
Read the private key at the default location. This will return an empty Optional if the location does not exist instead of throwing an exception. It should only throw throw an exception if the location actually exists but there is an issue reading a private key from it.

methods.name: readPrivateKeyStorage
methods.docu:
Read the private key at a given location. This will return an empty Optional if the location does not exist instead of throwing an exception. It should only throw throw an exception if the location actually exists but there is an issue reading a private key from it.

Parameters:

  • p_path Path to load the private key from

Returns: The private key or empty if the location did not exist

classes.name: AuthClientContext
classes.docu: Client context used for client authentication state.

methods.name: getSupportedDigestAlgorithms
methods.docu:
Get supported digest algorithms (to be sent to the server). The server will be matching this set to its own list of allowed digest algorithms.

Returns: Supported digest algorithms

methods.name: getSupportedCipherTransformations
methods.docu:
Get supported cipher transformations (to be sent to the server). The server will be matching this set to its own list of allowed cipher transformations.

Returns: Supported cipher transformations

methods.name: getAuthType
methods.docu:
Get the authentication type for this context.

Returns: AuthType for the context

methods.name: getAuthUser
methods.docu:
Get the authentication user for this context.

Returns: Authentication user for the context

methods.name: clone
methods.docu:
Clone the current AuthClientContext in an uninitialized state (before init).

Returns: Copy of this AuthClientcontext in an uninitialized state

methods.name: reset
methods.docu: Reset this AuthClientContext to an uninitialized state (for reuse)

methods.name: init
methods.docu:
Get the client authentication initialization object and change the state to expect a server response.

Returns: ClientAuthInit to send to the server

methods.name: process
methods.docu:
Process a ServerAuthResponse. If this response requires a ClientAuthResponse then it will be returned, otherwise the Optional will be empty. The return value will *only* be empty if the context is finished.

Parameters:

  • p_response AerverAuthResponse from the server

Returns: ClientAuthResponse if a client response is required, empty otherwise

methods.name: getState
methods.docu:
Get the current state of this authentication context.

Returns: Current state of the authentication context

methods.name: isFinished
methods.docu:
Is this authentication finished? Do we have a final result?

Returns: true is the authentication is finished

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.docu:
If the authentication is finished and successful then return true, otherwise false.

Returns: true is the authentication is finished and successful

methods.name: getFailure
methods.docu:
If the authentication is not successful return an exception. If the authentication is finished then this will be the final failure status from the server. Otherwise it will be a AuthWrongStateException saying that the authentication is not finished.

Returns: AuthException if not successful

classes.name: PublicKeyHelper
classes.docu: Static helper methods for public key authentication.

classes.name: AuthServerContext
classes.docu:
Server context used for server authentication state. This should always come
from a AuthServerContextFactory. Unlike the client authentication, this is
not driven by the API user, the client is the one who decides what
authentication is being used.

methods.name: getAuthType
methods.docu:
Get the authentication type for this context.

Returns: AuthType for the context

methods.name: getUser
methods.docu:
Get the user to authenticate.

Returns: User name to authenticate

methods.name: init
methods.docu:
Get the server authentication object, the initial data from the client was already provided in the AuthServerContextFactory. The context may either be finished after this or be expecting more from the client. The server *always* has something to say initially, even if that is just that the authentication failed.

Returns: ServerAuthResponse in response to client initialization

methods.name: process
methods.docu:
Process a ClientAuthResponse. Client responses *always* require a server response, even if that response is just an error.

Parameters:

  • p_response ClientAuthResponse from the client

Returns: ServerAuthResponse in response to client response

methods.name: getState
methods.docu:
Get the current state of this authentication context.

Returns: Current state of the authentication context

methods.name: isFinished
methods.docu:
Is this authentication finished? Do we have a final result?

Returns: true is the authentication is finished

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.docu:
If the authentication is finished and successful then return true, otherwise false.

Returns: true is the authentication is finished and successful

methods.name: getFailure
methods.docu:
If the authentication is not successful return an exception. If the authentication is finished then this will be the final failure status from the server. Otherwise it will be a Throwable saying that the authentication is not finished.

Returns: AuthException if not successful
